name: Click Indicator
description: Shows your own images while you click or hold, so you don't need a handcam. Works with macros and bots.

sprites.description: Shows your own image in the corner while you click or hold, so you don't need a handcam.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the click indicator in levels.

idle-image.name: Idle image
idle-image.description: Image shown while you are <cy>not</c> clicking. Leave empty for the built-in image. PNG recommended (transparent edges are cropped automatically).

pressed-image.name: Clicking image
pressed-image.description: Image shown while you <cg>are</c> clicking or holding. Leave empty for the built-in image.

corner.name: Corner
corner.description: Which corner of the screen the indicator sits in.

size.name: Size
size.description: Height of the image as a percentage of the screen height.

size.name: Size
size.description: Height of the indicator as a percentage of the screen height. Applies the next time you enter a level.

margin-x.name: Horizontal margin
margin-x.description: Distance from the left/right edge, as a percentage of the screen height. Negative values push it off the edge.

margin-y.name: Vertical margin
margin-y.description: Distance from the top/bottom edge, as a percentage of the screen height. Negative values push it off the edge.

margin.name: Margin
margin.description: Gap from the bottom-right corner, as a percentage of the screen height. Applies the next time you enter a level.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: How see-through the indicator is, in percent.
Opacity of the indicator in percent. Applies the next time you enter a level.

pressed-scale.name: Clicking image scale
pressed-scale.description: Makes the clicking image bigger or smaller than the idle one (1.0 = same size). Handy for a little 'pop' when you click.

trim.name: Crop transparent edges
trim.description: Automatically ignores empty transparent space around PNG images, so the picture sits right in the corner.

hide-idle.name: Only show while clicking
hide-idle.description: Hide the idle image completely, so the indicator only appears while you click or hold.

track.name: Track
track.description: Which player's clicks to show in 2-player / dual levels.

platformer-buttons.name: Count left/right (platformer)
platformer-buttons.description: In platformer levels, also treat holding left or right as clicking.
